层次与深度
Glass
深度通过玻璃、边框对比以及可复用的阴影或模糊处理来传达。请在主视觉面板、卡片与控件间保持这些配方一致，使页面读起来像同一套材质体系。
表面应优先呈现玻璃质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 1px padding and a 12px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.6), rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• keep spacing aligned to the detected 7.2px rhythm.
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• keep corner radii within the detected 11px, 12px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 150ms 与 300ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 悬停行为侧重 Text 与 Shadow 变化。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a ambient background using custom shaders. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: fluid wave field with black and sparse spacing. Build it from shader field so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback.
